rules.description: Every lesson starts with one shared ACQUIRE_UNDERSTAND stage and continues with one or more complete sections in the order PRACTISE, APPLY_DEMONSTRATE, MASTERY_TEST.
A lesson must represent one observable, assessable skill cluster; unrelated goals require separate lessons.
Only evidence from MASTERY_TEST can pass the lesson or unlock a prerequisite-dependent lesson.
Every mastery-test exercise set uses hintPolicy NONE and feedbackPolicy AFTER_TEST.
Every required mastery tag is sampled by the mastery-test blueprint.
A test cannot repeat exact recently shown items; it must use equivalent unseen variants while preserving skill difficulty.
Wrong answers generate durable mastery/error tags and a future review date.
Error review repeats the concept with a varied item rather than immediately repeating the exact same item.
Practice includes guided, fading-support and independent items with variation across values, contexts, order and distractors where applicable.
The explanation includes child-friendly definitions of all introduced terms, how the concept works, a correct-result rule, a worked example and a non-example.
Reading and spelling use correct child-friendly terms for sound, phoneme, letter, syllable, word part and spelling rule; visible text and spoken text remain separate.
Every math exercise representationId must be declared by the lesson and must match a representation used in the explanation or worked example.
A generator may not silently substitute a different calculation model from the model taught in that lesson.
Every geometry lesson has at least one GEOMETRY_DIAGRAM visual.
Every measurement lesson has at least one MEASUREMENT_DIAGRAM visual using the same units and scale conventions as the exercises.
Every world-knowledge lesson has at least one WORLD_BICOLOR_ILLUSTRATION visual with SVG and PNG paths.
World-knowledge illustrations use only PlanetGold, white and transparency; no other fill, stroke, gradient or embedded raster colour is allowed.
Every visual has localized alt text and readable labels where labels are required.
Every exercise set is either CURATED or GENERATED; mixed stages contain multiple sets instead of a third hybrid source mode.
Migrated curated exercise IDs remain stable across XML-to-catalog conversion.
Generated exercises are reproducible from profile/lesson/attempt seed, generator ID and generator version.
All child-visible content and required spoken content exist in nl-BE, fr-BE and en-US or use the explicitly approved fallback policy.
Migration never relocks already completed legacy content and never drops profiles, rewards, sync IDs or queued offline changes.
Main learning tiles, their routes and saved identifiers remain unchanged.
Every substantial content or visual update reports APK and asset size before and after.
